$comment: Copy to %APPDATA%\MindAttic\MindAttic.Scheduler\dbsync.json. Every field is optional: the numbers below are the defaults, and databases merge into the built-in list by name (see DbSyncSettings.DefaultDatabases), so an entry only gives what it changes. targetConnection is a full SQL Server connection string, or {ProviderName} to sign in as that service principal from %APPDATA%\MindAttic\Database\providers.json (Server, ClientId, ClientSecret) with the database named as here. A database with no targetConnection is reported 'not configured' and skipped.
